newsitem.title: UK: Heywood to buy back up to 10 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Heywood to buy back up to 10 pct of shares.

text.p: British building and car industry component maker Heywood Williams Group Plc said on Wednesday it planned to buy back up to 10 percent of its shares in the next few weeks.

"We have a particularly strong balance sheet, but a particularly weak share price," said the company in a statement. It said the best way to enhance shareholder value was to buy back shares and to concentrate efforts on improving the performance of its operations.
The firm also reported first half pre-tax profits before exceptional items had risen to 21.8 million stg from 15.3 million previously.
Heywood is maintaining its interim dividend at 5.0p per share.
The company said that although order books in the U.S. were less buoyant, it was encouraged by good order books in mainland Europe.
"Together these factors lead me to expect a satisfactory outcome for the year as a whole," said chairman Ralph Hinchliffe.
